question.problem: Find the value of $4$ raised to the second power.
question.worked_solution:
We need to evaluate $4^2.$

To evaluate $4^2,$ we write it out with multiplication signs and then compute the product:

$$
\begin{aligned}{4}^{2}={{4\times 4}_{⏟}}_{\text{[math]2[/math] times}}=16\end{aligned}
$$
